blurb: LeVan Merritt was born in Sandy Hook, Connecticut in 1806. He came to Medina in 1833 and for several years worked as a clerk on the canal docks. In 1840 he bought and became operator of a flour mill. In the same year he married Cynthia Loomis of Clarkson, NY and in 1841 built a home at 406 West Avenue.
